source_snapshot.items: All SSD Slot Number Check - NVMe
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert all NVMe SSDs into backplane slots and check slot numbers.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes device enumeration proves physical slots.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires operator photos and stable serial/NGUID-to-slot plus PCI/sysfs topology.

old_problem: Duplicate code with row433 was treated as an identity decision, and unstable `/dev/nvme` order was proposed as physical-slot proof.
disposition_reason: ED-02 explicitly preserves duplicate code variants by Source Key and Variant ID; row85 remains independently identifiable without modifying the Master. Exact slot map and insertion method are project configuration, and physical/PCI topology can be validated fail closed.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row85 all18 XLSX cells and history2695.
Preserved row85/Variant559b identity separately from row433 E.1s coverage.
Required stable serial/NGUID/BDF/backplane evidence and operator photos; no device was inserted or accessed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every approved NVMe SSD is installed in the specified physical bay and maps consistently through backplane, adapter/controller, PCIe BDF and OS namespace topology.
required_package: System slot-number specification and bay labels
Supported hot-swap versus powered-off insertion procedure
OS/boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/data protections, abort and restoration policy
test_case.test_command: Operator follows the approved powered-off or hot-swap procedure to install/verify each labeled SSD and photograph bay plus serial. Read-only agent collection captures nvme list/id, sysfs controller/namespace links, PCI BDF/root-port/slot data and health. Join only by stable serial/NGUID/WWN and compare the one-to-one chain with the approved slot map; never use `/dev/nvme` numbering as physical identity.
test_case.expected_result: Every required bay contains the expected stable-identity SSD, all controller/BDF/namespace relationships match the specification, no duplicate/missing identity exists and storage/platform health is clean.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete one-to-one approved map plus physical photo and stable-identity topology evidence for every slot. Device-name order alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Validate hot-swap support or require approved powered-off state.
Protect OS/boot/mounted/swap/LVM/RAID/data devices; no writes or formatting.
Abort on identity mismatch, unexpected disappearance, media/PCIe error or unsafe power state; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant identity and approved slot specification
Mismatch analysis, system logs and restoration
test_case.recovery: On wrong-slot identity or device loss, stop further handling, preserve stable-ID/PCI/sysfs/kernel evidence, do not format or remap storage, and have the operator return hardware only through the approved power/hot-swap procedure under storage-owner control.

source_conflict.reason: ED-02 resolves duplicate-code identity through Source Key and Variant ID; row85 slot mapping remains distinct from row433.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; project slot map and safe operator procedure gate execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind stable-ID slot/topology map, insertion mode, operator evidence and storage protections.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; missing authoritative map prevents execution/PASS.

project_authority: Physical slot map and insertion support are project-specific inputs.
